final:
settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
  ex settings(["level", "x"], ["5", "y"]) == ["fast", "5", "y"]
  ex settings(["mode", "a", "a"], ["slow", "1", "2"]) == ["slow", "3", "2"]
  var mode = "fast"
  var level = "3"
  var names: List[str] = []
  var others: List[str] = []
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    let k = keys[i]
    let v = values[i]
    if k == "mode"
      mode = copy v
      continue
    if k == "level"
      level = copy v
      continue
    var found = 0 - 1
    for j in range(0, names.len())
      if names[j] == k
        found = j
    if found >= 0
      others[found] = copy v
    else
      names.append(copy k)
      others.append(copy v)
  var res: List[str] = [copy mode, copy level]
  for o in others
    res.append(copy o)
  res
